findings.claim: The Foodinho records recover a concrete loop from pervasive worker data to rating, opportunity allocation and possible exclusion.
limits: No universal prevalence, named intent, liability or extra-record causation is inferred.

findings.claim: Repeated enforcement years apart makes correction and system-outcome reconciliation a first-class state rather than a one-time compliance promise.
limits: No universal prevalence, named intent, liability or extra-record causation is inferred.

findings.claim: Contestability requires more than disclosing that an algorithm exists; it requires a route to human intervention, worker expression and challenge.
limits: No universal prevalence, named intent, liability or extra-record causation is inferred.

findings.claim: The records do not reconstruct which individual rider lost which order, income or account access because of a particular score.
limits: No universal prevalence, named intent, liability or extra-record causation is inferred.

observations.claim: The 2021 Foodinho record covered approximately 19,000 riders and imposed a EUR 2.6 million sanction.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

observations.claim: The platform processed chats, emails, calls, geolocation approximately every 15 seconds, routes, estimated and actual times, order history, feedback and device battery level.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

observations.claim: The rating formula penalized delayed acceptance or refusal and favored timely acceptance and completed orders, including a 30-second acceptance component.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

observations.claim: The authority identified risks of reduced delivery allocation or exclusion and deficiencies in human intervention, worker expression and contestation.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

observations.claim: A later 2024 record imposed a EUR 5 million sanction involving more than 35,000 riders and again emphasized contestability.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

observations.claim: The 2024 record also reported geolocation outside working hours through August 2023.
limits: Bounded to the named public record and stated jurisdiction.

title: Foodinho / Glovo: rating, opportunity allocation, contestability and repeated enforcement
